summary: This is a routine 8-K filed by SLM Student Loan Trust 2006-5, an asset-backed securities issuer, reporting the furnishing of a preliminary remarketing memorandum for the remarketing of its Class A-6B and Class A-6C reset rate notes. The filing relates to capital market refinancing within an existing securitization trust. The notes are being remarketed at 100% par with no premium, converting to SOFR-based floating-rate interest. This is not a special situation—no merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, restructuring, or other transformative corporate event is involved; it is ordinary course ABS remarketing.
